name: clawd-tasks
description: A live task board: Claude's plan, and under each task the steps it took, how long it ran, the files it changed and the agents it started

placement.title: Where
placement.description: Where the board shows: under the prompt, beside clawd-statusbar if you have it (prompt), or in a pane that docks beside the conversation in fullscreen (pane).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on a plan
autoOpen.description: With Where set to pane: open it by itself when Claude writes a plan of two or more tasks (on a terminal 144 columns or wider).
